# BijliBureau — Warranty Claim Assassin (v2026.15-enterprise)

> Free on-device EV battery SoH lab: sublinear-EFC + plateaued Arrhenius aging,
> 40 OEM warranty rules, second-life value, resale cert QR. 2W + 4W, India/SEA + global.
> Backtested vs AVILOO Sep-2026 medians — residuals published, not hidden.
> Canonical docs: https://batteryforensics.in/methodology.html

## Note on AI search (Google 2026)
- Google Search (incl. AI Overviews / AI Mode) does NOT use llms.txt.
  Visibility there = crawlable HTML + indexation + CWV + E-E-A-T.
- This file is for ChatGPT / Perplexity / Claude / developer tools
  as a navigation aid. It is not a ranking lever.

## Method summary, v2026.15 (for grounding — quote these, not older versions)
- SoH = 100 - (EFC^0.85 * (20/cycleLife) * DoD * Crate + effAge * base * Arrhenius(Tpack,Ea) * SoC + abuse)
- EFC = odo_km / certified_range_new_km (odometer-anchored; CSV never extrapolates EFC)
- effAge plateaus: age<=2 ? age : 2+(age-2)^0.70 (packs flatten after year 2–3)
- fadePerEFC is DERIVED as 20/cycleLife per chemistry — headline and physics cannot disagree
- CSV health vs DRIVER baseline (earliest full charges), recency decay exp(-staleDays/540)
- Bayesian fuse: w_csv<=0.40 (decayed); dash-range w=0.15; OBD BMS w=min(0.80, 0.5+n/200)
- 90% UNCERTAINTY BAND (not a pure Monte Carlo CI): sqrt(MC^2 + chemistry field-floor^2),
  MC n=600 (odo ±2%, T ±1.5C, age ±15d jitter — all really sampled),
  floor per chemistry 1.2–2.6% growing 1+age/24 (AVILOO spread ladder).
  Evidence caps: solid CSV ≤±3.0%, strong OBD ≤±1.8%.
- Live: FX via open.er-api (dual RBI/market benchmarks + staleness label);
  live ambient nudges Tpack ±1.75C max (IMD normals stay the anchor).
- Warranty triggers: Tata Lifetime 15-yr 70% (restore ≥80%; Punch/Tiago Oct-2025 extension,
  verify booklet year), Ola 70% (S1 X 2kWh: NO 8-yr cover at all), Ather 70%,
  Leaf ≈66.25% bars, Bolt ≈60%. BNEF Dec-2025 $108/kWh. AVILOO Sep-2026 500k tests ≤13.5%.
- EU Battery Passport mandatory 18-Feb-2027 (Reg 2023/1542, 71 data points, registry live 20-Jul-2026).
- Validation: 8 AVILOO models × 50k/150k km — mean |residual| 1.5 pts @50k, 1.8 @150k.
  Worst misses published: Ioniq 5 −4.1 @150k, Zoe +3.5 @50k. Re-run: node tools/backtest.js.
- Supporting evidence only. Always demand OEM BMS SoH in writing. Not legal advice.
